countingNote: newWords are actual first exercised content spellings; newForms, newSenses and names are separate. Predictable passive forms do not inflate lexical growth. Recognition of tāne/wahine in week 1 precedes translation in week 8. Introduced in a draft is not linguistic approval or mastery.

priority: Current sentence structures and earlier vocabulary
Useful overlap with the common-word reference
selectionPolicy.frequency: A cross-check after topic selection. Never split frequency ranks into lesson or level quotas.
selectionPolicy.weeklyBudget: Around 15 new items including existing lesson introductions. Lighter introduction and revision weeks stay light. Optional words do not count toward the core plan.
selectionPolicy.courseTarget: 900 is the capacity of 60 weeks at 15 words, not a requirement to pad every week.
selectionPolicy.optional: Related extensions stay attached to their topic for later selection; they are not scheduled introductions.
